{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK citing previously documented surprising negation behavior"
    },
    {
      "login": "ryanofsky",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "ACK 8731550b059b; suggested release note, error wording, commit message details, and functional tests"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4602822953",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "rename NEGATE_TO_DEFAULT to NEGATE_TO_EMPTY and have GetArg() return empty string instead of nullopt",
      "quote": "I'd suggest renaming NEGATE_TO_DEFAULT to NEGATE_TO_EMPTY and having GetArg() return \"\" instead of std::nullopt.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author renamed to NEGATE_TO_EMPTY returning empty string",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4626525635"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4626525635",
      "status_by_quote": "Done as suggested"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4602823499",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "make -noblocksdir an error instead of falling back to default blocksdir",
      "quote": "Treating an empty -blocksdir= as unset looks good, but I think -noblocksdir should be an error instead of falling back to the default directory.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author disallowed negation of -blocksdir",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4626521670"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4626521670",
      "status_by_quote": "Done with `DISALLOW_NEGATION`."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4602823756",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "treat -nobantime the same as -bantime=0 rather than disallowing negation",
      "quote": "The exception is -bantime. \"No ban time\" can only mean a ban time of 0, or not banning, so I think -nobantime should just be treated the same as -bantime=0, whether 0 ends up allowed or rejected",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed -bantime handling from the PR",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4626521357"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4626521357",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, I removed `-bantime` from the commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4602824031",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "make -nowalletdir an error instead of falling back to the default wallet directory",
      "quote": "I don't think -nowalletdir should fall back to the default wallet directory, for the same reason as -noblocksdir",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author disallowed negation of -nowalletdir",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4626521040"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4626521040",
      "status_by_quote": "Done"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4602824369",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "make -notorcontrol an error while -listenonion is enabled or also handle -torcontrol=0",
      "quote": "I think it would be safer to make -notorcontrol an error while -listenonion is enabled, asking the user to pass -nolistenonion if that's what they want, instead of soft-setting -listenonion=0.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author made -notorcontrol an error",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4626520570"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4626520570",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, made `-notorcontrol` an error."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4682939306",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add a release note for newly rejected startup options",
      "quote": "Not blocking, but it might be worth adding a short release note, since some settings that used to be accepted now fail at startup",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added release note in a new commit",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4687251685"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4687251685",
      "status_by_quote": "Added a release note in a new commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4683289347",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "clarify error message connecting -notorcontrol and -listenonion",
      "quote": "I think an error explaining how these are connected could be more helpful here",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted suggested error message",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4687252494"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4687252494",
      "status_by_quote": "Taken, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4683423642",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add tests for options modified by NEGATE_TO_EMPTY",
      "quote": "This only checks that the node starts with -noi2psam -norpcpassword, so most options changed in this commit have no test showing that -nofoo now does something sensible.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author included provided test suite changes into the commit",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4687255011"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4687255011",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, I added them to the `NEGATE_TO_EMPTY` commit with you as co-author and dropped the startup check."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6899435975",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "the surprising nature of the negations was documented a few times",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5942750123",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "\"no\" should mean none, false, or zero, or else be an error; avoid clever interpretations like \"default\" or \"unlimited\"",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:6042975586",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "fixes options where -nofoo did the opposite of what it says, failed startup, or crashed the node, and makes negation behave predictably",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "ryanofsky provided full ACK along with several suggestions (release note, error message improvement, and test additions) which fjahr adopted in an updated push.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review of updated branch after feedback was incorporated and branch rebased",
      "id": "c:7146161556"
    }
  ]
}
